title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning and surface audit logs
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 constraints that pin KMS keys to allowed regions and improve audit logging for any cross-region KMS bindings. Motivation: customers operating under data residency and compliance constraints require deterministic enforcement when KMS keys are configured for private deployments. Previously we only emitted audit entries (audit mode) and some downstream components would silently accept incompatible bindings, which led to an incident (SUP-1284). This change adds enforcement at the RBAC evaluator level, surfaces richer audit events for attempted violations, and provides a rollout plan to avoid disruption.

What changed: added region pinning validation to the RBAC v2 evaluator and a policy layer that checks KMS key metadata (region alias, kms:region tag) against resource residency constraints. When a mismatch is detected: - in audit mode: an AUDIT_KMS_REGION_PINNING event is emitted with details about resource, user, requested action, key-id, and key-region. - in enforce mode: the evaluator denies the binding/action and emits an ENFORCE_KMS_REGION_PINNING event.

Migration & rollout: default for existing tenants stays in "audit" mode. New enterprise tenants enrolling after 2025-11-20 will have policy set to "enforce" by default (documented in release notes). We added a Linear task (ENG-3498) that operators can use to opt-in tenants to enforce mode. A canary rollout was performed against the staging and two low-traffic dedicated clusters for 72 hours before broad rollout.

Testing: unit and integration tests added for validator, policy resolution, and audit event shapes. Added an E2E scenario that simulates a cross-region KMS binding and verifies deny + audit event contents. Updated RBAC docs with examples of allowed/denied KMS policies.

References: ENG-3421 (RBAC v2 KMS work), SUP-1284 (customer incident), internal runbook link: /docs/runbooks/security/kms-region-pinning (ref).

merge_commit_message:
rbac(v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit events

Enables deterministic enforcement for KMS region constraints and adds richer audit telemetry. Defaults: existing tenants remain audit-only. See docs/rbac/kms-region-pinning.md for migration steps.
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now enforces KMS region pinning when configured. Existing tenants remain in audit mode by default; new enterprise tenants default to enforce. Added audit events: AUDIT_KMS_REGION_PINNING and ENFORCE_KMS_REGION_PINNING. See docs/rbac/kms-region-pinning.md for migration and runbook.
